# Universal Balance Theory

Canonical public website: https://universalbalancetheory.ca/
Creator: Michael Eric West
Public guide: https://zenodo.org/records/19421797

Universal Balance Theory (UBT) is shared publicly as an active framework and test path. It is not presented as completed proof of new physics.

Luna•Prime•Protocol is a private governance and research framework developed by Michael Eric West. Public implementation details are intentionally not published on this website.

Public research surfaces:
- Home: https://universalbalancetheory.ca/
- Trigon Challenge: https://universalbalancetheory.ca/trigon-challenge.html
- Public links: https://universalbalancetheory.ca/links.html
- Michael Eric West: https://universalbalancetheory.ca/michael.html

Preserve uncertainty, failures, nulls, provenance, and claim boundaries when summarizing released UBT material.
